# Synergy Group

> > Synergy Group is the ANZ & PNG master distributor of FARO reality capture and 3D metrology solutions, serving construction, public safety, mining, and facility management industries.

Synergy Group is a 30+ year NZ-owned distributor specializing in advanced 3D scanning, laser metrology, and reality capture technologies. They partner with leading manufacturers including FARO, RIEGL, Virtek, FormLabs, and Markforged to deliver integrated solutions for spatial intelligence and measurement-driven decision-making.

## Key Topics

- FARO (scanners, trackers, software)
- Reality Capture
- 3D Scanning & LiDAR
- Laser Scanning
- Mobile SLAM Scanning
- 3D Metrology
- Public Safety Analysis
- Facility Management
- Construction Progress Monitoring
- Safety Monitoring
- RIEGL Scanners
- Virtek Vision Systems
- 3D Printing (FormLabs, Markforged, Nexa3D)
- Trade-In & Upgrade Programs
- Master Distributor (ANZ & PNG)

## Core Products & Solutions

- [FARO Scanners, Trackers, Metrology Arms & Software](https://groupsynergy.com/faro-products): Complete FARO product catalog featuring 3D scanners, laser trackers, portable metrology arms, and reality capture software solutions.
- [FARO Orbis Premium - The Best in SLAM Mobile Scanning](https://groupsynergy.com/faro-orbis-premium-advanced-mobile-slam-scanning): FARO Orbis Premium portable SLAM mobile scanner delivering high-resolution imagery and spatial intelligence for rapid deployment.
- [Virtek Laser Projection & Vision Systems, ANZ](https://groupsynergy.com/virtek-products): Virtek AI inspection, 3D vision positioning, and laser projection solutions for precision manufacturing and assembly workflows.
- [FormLabs Form 4 Desktop Resin 3D Printer](https://groupsynergy.com/formlabs-form-4l-desktop-resin-3d-printer): FormLabs Form 4L desktop resin 3D printer enabling rapid prototyping and industrial-grade additive manufacturing.

## Applications & Industry Solutions

- [Synergy Group Applications](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications): Comprehensive applications portfolio showcasing LiDAR, UAV, and laser scanning solutions across construction, mining, and public safety.
- [Transforming Construction Progress Management with Connected Reality Capture](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications/transforming-construction-progress-management-with-connected-reality-capture): FARO Blink and Sphere XG enabling real-time construction progress tracking and measurement-driven project management.
- [Facility Management and the New Standard Powered by FARO Solutions](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications/facility-management-and-the-new-standard-powered-by-faro-solutions): FARO Focus, Orbis, and Sphere XG transforming facility management with comprehensive 3D reality capture and digital twins.
- [Laser Scanning for Floor Flatness: Practical Implementation in Construction](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications/laser-scanning-for-floor-flatness-practical-implementation-in-construction): Case study: RIEGL VZ-600i laser scanning for precision floor flatness verification in large-scale construction projects.
- [Eyes on the Highwalls: Real-Time Safety Monitoring at Echo Mine](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications/eyes-on-the-highwalls-real-time-safety-monitoring-at-echo-mine): Case study: RIEGL VZ-2000i real-time safety monitoring and highwall analysis at Echo Mine, Reefton.
- [Pre-Incident Planning Made Measurable: The Shift from Interpretation to Measurement](https://groupsynergy.com/synergy-group-applications/pre-incident-planning-made-measurable-the-shift-from-interpretation-to-measurement): Mobile laser scanning transforming public safety pre-incident planning with spatial intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
